description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem. Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses. We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones. But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you! What will you be doing? Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market; Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle); Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer; Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs; Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce; Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process; Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features. What we are looking for Fluent in Danish both written and spoken, as if it were your first language; Excellent communication and video presentation skills; Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets; Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives; Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives; Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle; Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound; Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team; Customer-centric mindset; You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain. What we offer Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support Interview Process Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual Final Interview - 30 mins - IRL/Virtual Values Interview - 30mins IRL AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for an Account Executive to cover the Belgium and Luxembourg markets. Enterprise Account Executives have a critical role and responsibility to deliver new client acquisition in zero-base accounts, while also ensuring successful relationships and revenue growth with existing customers.  

OneTrust is a fast-growing SaaS enterprise platform with a strong growth trajectory. We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals. 

Your Mission

The Account Executive (AE) is responsible for consistently generating, qualifying, and executing opportunities that support our customers in the pursuit of becoming more trusted organizations and drive revenue for OneTrust. AEs are expected to use their thorough knowledge of the industry and excellent value-based sales skills to create the best solutions and solve complex customer problems. AEs must bring useful insights and best practices to customers and prospects. 

You Are

  • Meet or exceed quota 
  • Conduct outreach to generate pipeline consistently even when engaged in closing activities 
  • Demonstrate resourcefulness to identify & leverage stakeholders, leaders, and champions to drive execution of the sales strategy appropriately 
  • Work effectively in a cross-functional manner with Business Development, Partner Channel, and Solutions Engineering to successfully land and expand key accounts 
  • Utilize two-sided discovery & impeccable communication to understand the customers’ needs and articulate valuable solutions 
  • Understand key competitors and their strategies to clearly differentiate OneTrust’s solutions in the marketplace 
  • Establish customer relationships that enable OneTrust to be viewed as a trusted advisor 
  • Manage and optimize a targeted geographic territory 

Your Experience Includes

You are someone with a hunting mentality and consultative approach. You bring curiosity, innovation, authenticity, leadership, and integrity to your work. You have experience communicating with C-Level Executives effectively, and you are confident in your communication skills. You approach new prospecting activities and deal-advancing activities with the utmost balance, and you are well-disciplined in sales processes and CRM hygiene. 

Your experience includes: 

  • Strong experience selling B2B Enterprise-level software or related technologies, ideally 12+ years, but exceptions may be made for the right candidate 
    Previous experience in Value Selling 
  • Strong track record of performance with landing net new logos while growing and supporting existing key accounts 
  • Previous experience running sales presentation/demos  
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.com or similar CRM solution
  • Fluent in Dutch and/or French
  • Fluent in English


Extra Awesome

  • Experience in Privacy, Security, Third-Party Risk management, Compliance  
  • Experience directly selling into the Information Security department 
  • CIPP/E or CIPM certified  
  • Trained in Command of Message  

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources  

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

  • OneTrust Careers on YouTube

description: About Us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production. The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI. You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster. What you’ll do: Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage What you’ll bring: 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them. Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake) Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs. This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. description: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos du poste Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise. Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous. Les missions : Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine). Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS). Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée. Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu. Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle. Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord. Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act). S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts. Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR. ▪️ Le profil idéal 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...) Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A) Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA Un plus Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…) Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini), Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks ▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. ▪️ Tes conditions de travail Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. ▪️ Le processus de recrutement Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence. description: Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale. Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution. En tant qu’alternant·e Sales Development Representative, tu es le premier point de contact et le premier maillon de notre chaîne commerciale. Ton rôle est stratégique : transformer l’intérêt d’un prospect en une opportunité commerciale réelle pour les Account Executives. Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions en soutien de l'équipe Sales En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR). Tes missions consisteront à : • Prendre en main la qualification : Réaliser les premiers échanges téléphoniques avec les prospects ayant formulé une demande de devis pour instaurer un premier contact de confiance. • Comprendre les besoins : T'entraîner à analyser les problématiques rencontrées au sein des copropriétés et présenter les offres Matera. • Assister les Account Executives : Participer à la prise de rendez-vous de démonstration et épauler les AE dans le suivi des prospects, la préparation des assemblées générales et les tâches administratives. • Découvrir nos outils Sales : Participer à la tenue à jour de notre CRM (Hubspot) et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de suivi. • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue : Proposer tes idées et participer aux projets internes visant à fluidifier nos processus commerciaux. description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. Your expertise in Python, DBT, SQL, and Databricks will drive operational efficiency, accelerate our month-end close, and deliver strategic insights that inform capital allocation and IPO readiness. This is a greenfield opportunity to own the analytics roadmap, work directly with Finance leadership, and build infrastructure that powers both scaling and compliance, all at a pivotal moment for Mews

What you would do

  • Design and develop analytical features that surface actionable insights for Finance leadership
  • Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL
  • Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques
  • Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders
  • Collaborate across Finance to translate business requirements into technical implementations
  • Advocate for modern data practices and continuous improvement of the stack

What you would bring

  • Hands-on production experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines (minimum 3 years)
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python; strong experience with DBT or equivalent modern data transformation tools
  • Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture
  • Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems
  • Demonstrated commitment to data quality, testing and accuracy; take pride in work that's been thoroughly validated
  • AI Fluency Level 3: In this role, you'll redesign how Finance approaches data discovery and analysis using AI—not just automating your own work, but building patterns and tools that shape how the whole team questions data and validates insights. You'll use AI to accelerate model development and testing, but critically, you'll actively question what it produces and know when to push back. You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.
  • For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

Nice to have

  • Experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI
  • Background working with regulated or governed data
  • Experience scaling analytics in fast-growing startups or scale-ups

Global benefits

Local benefits

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

description:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.

In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.

If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:

  • Lead analytical architecture and governance: Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.
  • Build governed data models and semantic layers: Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Establish analytics engineering best practices: Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Enable secure, reliable data access: Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.
  • Partner across the business: Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.
  • Mentor and enable the team: Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Drive platform evolution: Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You

  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.
  • Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.
  • Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments.
  • Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India.
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.
  • Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data.
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
  • Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.
  • You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture!

 

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

description: Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later. About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle. The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours. It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields. What you'll be doing Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others What you'll need You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick Nice to have Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar) Our stack Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Growth organization identifies, shapes, captures, and grows new opportunities for the company.

This role sits within the Connected Warfare Division. Connected Warfare builds the software and hardware substrate for global, multi-domain command and control (C2) — joint, time-sensitive, connected mesh ecosystems that link every robot, human, and sensor across every domain to close kill chains and enable mission autonomy. The division includes the Voyager team, which delivers ruggedised computing and communications platforms for the network edge.

About the Job

  • This is a sales role. You are here to hunt and close new business for Connected Warfare across Europe and the Middle East.
  • Based in continental Europe, you'll report to the Head of Growth for Anduril's International Connected Warfare business. You carry initial responsibility for the region, with scope to expand as the business scales.
  • European defence environments come with sovereign requirements, legacy architectures, and security constraints. You will know these pain points cold and demonstrate how Anduril integrates with — and supercharges — the systems customers already operate.
  • The work is matrixed: you'll pull on programs, engineering, capture, software, finance, partners, and customers to win. The deliverable is unambiguous: pipeline, partners, and signed contracts. This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports. Your impact is measured in the business you build and the contracts you close

What You’ll Do

Identify, qualify, shape, and close complex opportunities with Allied nations, navigating international procurement cycles and sovereign requirements to secure long-term programs of record.

  • Map customer requirements. Build a working understanding of regional defence requirements, security constraints, and legacy architectures. Show how Anduril's open architecture integrates with sovereign systems to solve real operational problems.

  • Deliver the number. Hit financial performance targets and build the multi-year plan to back them up. Provide leadership with long-term growth and product strategy for Connected Warfare in region.
  • Inform product. Translate region-specific mission profiles, sovereign cloud requirements, and degraded-network realities back into the product roadmap.
  • Represent Anduril. Communicate technical and operational value to senior military officials, procurement officers, and partners — articulating how Lattice-enabled C2 closes kill chains in contested environments

Growth Activities

  • Use Salesforce as the system of record — accounts, pricing, points of contact, expected close dates, and all customer activity
  • Partner with Sales Engineering to refine customer solutions
  • Perform live and static demonstrations on-site or via VTC
  • Create and deliver client presentations and proposals tailored to specific customer needs
  • Identify regional contract vehicles (e.g. NATO frameworks, national procurement programmes) and lead proposal development

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in defence, dual-use, or enterprise networking sales, with at least 5 years closing business with European government and military customers
  • A proven hunter: documented record of identifying, qualifying, and closing complex deals with European Ministries of Defence (MoDs), NATO bodies, or coalition partners — opened the door, shaped the requirement, closed the contract
  • Deep familiarity with European defence procurement cycles, budgeting, and sovereign security frameworks
  • Ability to quickly master highly technical concepts (mesh networking, edge compute, C2, cloud architecture) and credibly brief senior military and technical leaders
  • A builder with high agency: has stood up a regional pipeline, country, or business line from a standing start — not just managed an existing book. Owns outcomes, prioritizes ruthlessly, operates well in greenfield environments
  • Operates effectively in a matrixed organization — partners well with BL leadership, engineering, capture, and corporate functions. Low ego, high collaboration
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing a regional channel — resellers, system integrators, and prime partnerships
  • Strong command of capture management or an equivalent enterprise sales pursuit methodology
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and negotiation skills
  • Native or fluent English; a second European language (Dutch, German, French) or Arabic is a plus
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Europe and the Middle East
  • Right to work in the EU; eligible to obtain and maintain EU and/or NATO-level security clearances

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior operational or industry experience in C4ISR, JADC2, or tactical communications — including service in an allied military, intelligence, or government digital/IT function
  • Established network within European military headquarters, defence procurement agencies, and European defence primes
  • Experience supporting export-controlled programs (US ITAR / EAR, UK Export Control, EU dual-use) and navigating sovereign data residency / cloud hosting regulations
  • Experience standing up a new sales region for a defence-tech or enterprise networking company


Europe and the Middle East are rearming. The next decade of defence spend in this region will be measured in the billions, and the contracts being shaped right now will run for twenty years. We're hiring the person who's going to win our share of it.

description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

description: Worum es geht MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen. Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig. Was du bei uns machst Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team in Leipzig, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen. Deine Schwerpunkte: Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren. Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran. Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen. Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases. Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt. Was wir suchen Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype. Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat. Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein. Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle. Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen. Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren. Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich. Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch. Arbeiten bei MAIA Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung. Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest. Bewerbung und nächste Schritte Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten? Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Set the operating rhythm: pipeline reviews, prioritisation, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement. Deep Product & Design Engineering market immersion: credible, active network in the UK. Ideally you have run meetups and build communities. Exec-search level craft: evidence of closing low-volume, very high-calibre engineers via creative, non-standard routes (not just inbound + job boards or Linkedin). description: About the Team The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies. The Codex Applied AI Engineering team focuses on helping organizations transform how software is built with AI. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate. About the Role We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join as Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex), leading a team of Applied AI Engineers responsible for driving successful Codex adoption across strategic customers. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development. As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale — setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. You will serve as both a people leader and senior technical advisor, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering to translate customer needs and real-world usage into better technical approaches, reusable patterns, and product insights. Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI. This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In This Role, You Will Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI Engineers supporting Codex customers across strategic accounts. Own the operating model and technical engagement strategy for Codex Applied AI Engineering, helping customers move from initial exploration to meaningful, scaled adoption. Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures. Act as the senior technical escalation point and thought partner for complex customer implementations and engineering challenges. Partner with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering teams to align customer outcomes with product direction and roadmap priorities. Establish repeatable technical patterns, playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices that enable broader adoption of AI-powered software development. Coach Applied AI Engineers to operate as trusted technical partners to engineering leaders, executives, and highly technical customer teams. Synthesize insights from customer engagements and translate them into actionable feedback for Product, Research, and Engineering. Develop a deep understanding of how customers are using Codex, where they encounter friction, and where new technical approaches or product capabilities could unlock greater impact. Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries. You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles. Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers. Have experience building or deploying generative AI, developer platforms, agentic systems, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments. Possess strong hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript. Understand modern software development lifecycles and have strong intuition for how AI and coding agents can change how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained. Can work directly with customer engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems, develop technical approaches, and turn ideas into working solutions. Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders. Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy building new operating models, technical patterns, and teams from first principles. description: Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein. Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties. Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie. Sturing en beheersing Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten. Verandering en verbetering Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur; Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie; Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office; Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology; Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties; Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst; Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten; Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur. Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk; Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology. Wat vragen we van jou? Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren. Dit breng je minimaal mee: WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management; Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen; Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving; Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams; Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert; Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  1. Stratégie & Transformation
  2. Finance, Risque & Conformité
  3. Product, Innovation & Design
  4. Data & Analytics
  5. Conseil Tech (Advisory)

Descriptif du poste

En tant que Managing Principal au sein de Capco France dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients, Banque de Financement et d’Investissement, Asset Servicers et Asset Managers, en France et à l’international, afin de contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

En collaboration avec les autres partners en charge des comptes clients et nos practices, vous serez en charge d’identifier et de transformer de nouvelles opportunités d’affaires auprès de nos clients.

Dans ce cadre, vous piloterez également l’exécution des projets vendus, qui sont de nature complexe et à forte valeur ajoutée, couvrant l’un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants :

  • Transformation organisationnelle et opérationnelle : Redéfinir les modèles opérationnels, organisationnels et l’architecture fonctionnelle pour les départements de marchés de capitaux (Front, Middle, Back-office, Risques), déploiement de processus optimisés et alignés sur les meilleures pratiques du marché.
  • Cadrage et gestion de programmes complexes : superviser, du cadrage à la mise en œuvre, des plans moyen-termes et des projets de transformation à grande échelle (ex : refonte des systèmes, mise en conformité réglementaire, réorganisation…).
  • Accompagnement de projets réglementaires : Accompagner les clients dans la mise en conformité avec les principales réglementations des marchés de capitaux (MiFID 2, EMIR, Dodd-Frank, PRIIPS, SFTR, FATCA…).
  • Transformation Finance & Risques : Refonte des dispositifs de contrôle des risques (marché, contrepartie, crédit, opérationnels), des outils et processus de reporting, pilotage de la performance.
  • Mise en œuvre de technologies et d’innovations : concevoir des architectures fonctionnelles alignées avec les stratégies métiers, superviser l'implémentation de progiciels financiers (ex. : Murex, Calypso, Simcorp…) et de nouvelles technologies innovantes (IA, automatisation des processus, big data, blockchain) pour améliorer la performance des opérations de marché.
  • Stratégie et gouvernance de la donnée : définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de gestion des données, accompagner les enjeux d’exploitation, de confidentialité et de sécurité des données.

Au-delà de vos interventions et des missions que vous superviserez, votre rôle consistera également à assurer :

  • Le développement commercial du cabinet dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux : pilotage de relations clients en direct ou en appui des équipes clients, origination d’opportunités business, contribution à la transformation des opportunités en missions concrètes.
  • Le développement de nos offres et services et la croissance des équipes Marché de Capitaux : développement de contenu, partage de nos visions et convictions, développement des compétences internes (recrutement et formation).

Savoir-Faire et Savoir-être

Les caractéristiques suivantes sont requises :

  • Expérience :

    • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de programmes et projets de transformation complexes, depuis le cadrage jusqu’au pilotage, et dans des missions métiers (gestion post-trade, finance, risque et conformité) et/ou technologiques.
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Expertise en stratégie d’une banque de financement et d’Investissement, de son architecture fonctionnelle, de son organisation, de ses métiers et processus et de ses enjeux.
    • Maîtrise des méthodes de gestion de programme / projet, en cycle V ou en agile.
    • Connaissance des instruments financiers et des principes de gestion des risques (marché, contrepartie et crédit).
    • Connaissance des progiciels de marché.
    • Connaissance des nouvelles technologies, des progiciels de marché et des systèmes d’informations des BFI, ainsi qu’une expérience dans le cadrage ou la réalisation de projets de transformation IT dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux serait un réel atout pour ce poste.
  • Soft skills :
    • Leadership avéré et capacité à encadrer des équipes seniors.
    • Excellent niveau de communication, grande aisance rédactionnelle.
    • Fortes compétences en gestion de la relation client.
    • Esprit analytique et capacité à structurer des démarches et à résoudre des problématiques complexes.
    • Orienté résultats, avec un sens aigu du client et de ses enjeux métiers et technologiques.
    • Forte autonomie en matière de relation client, de développement commercial, de pilotage de missions et de développement des collaborateurs.
    • Appétence à challenger le statuquo et capacité à s’adapter aux évolutions technologiques
  • Formation et langues
    • Diplômé(e) d’une grande école d’ingénieurs ou école de commerce (Bac+5)
    • Maîtrise impérative du français et de l’anglais dans un environnement professionnel.
    • Vous savez évoluer dans un contexte international.


Chez Capco, nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise

description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Wingtra builds professional drones that help people map and understand the world. Join the team creating our next aircraft and the tools that build and test it. You’ll be a hands-on generalist who combines mechatronic design and system integration. You’ll work for drone operators and for our colleagues on the production floor. We’re early adopters of AI and build agents into everyday engineering. We want you to keep expanding what we can design, build and test. Responsibilities Design what flies and what attaches to it. You design, integrate and qualify mechanical and mechatronic assemblies for the drone and its accessories. That covers mounts and interfaces, plus sensors and actuators working together. You team up with our electronics designers and suppliers to get designs that can be manufactured. Build the rigs that prove it. You develop qualification rigs and production QC setups. You design fixtures and adapters in CAD, integrate PCBAs and instruments and wire sensors and actuators. Then you bring up the whole system, debug and iterate it until it’s reliable. Automate the checks. You integrate a Raspberry Pi and write Python tools for flashing, calibration and end-of-line checks. You build the operator interface with serial-number traceability and robust data pipeline. Make every test mean something. You design for testability. You use requirements and FMEA to define tests and to justify pass/fail limits. You validate measurement accuracy and repeatability, diagnose faults and improve production yield. Take it to the line. You commission QC stations with the Production Engineers on shared infrastructure. You support their takeover and resolve issues through ramp-up. You leave behind tools and documentation they can maintain. Requirements You have depth in one engineering discipline. You’ve also integrated mechanics, electronics and software into systems that work. We value complementary strengths and practical ownership across disciplines. You enjoy product design and test engineering alike. Building tools that make your colleagues on the production floor faster and happier is part of the fun. AI agents already help you learn, design, code and analyze. You check what they produce, invent better workflows and share what works with the team. You prototype fast, debug systematically and keep going until something is reliable enough for someone else to use. You’ll sit in the Engineering team with real ownership, from the first concept to a working production line. You’re based in Zurich. During commissioning and ramp-up, you’ll spend time with our production partners in Europe and the USA. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.
