description: About Seamflow Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. Where we are: Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze. Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it. You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week. What we're looking for We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not. What we're actually screening for: You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed. You build genuinely good interfaces, and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires. You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship. Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build. You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs. Signals we like, none of them required: founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain. This is probably not for you if You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch. You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning. You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane. description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

 

AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

 

Role Summary  

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Platform Reliability Engineering Manager leads the platform reliability team: the engineers who take on incidents escalated from the Global and Site Operation Centres and manage them through to resolution, and the Service Delivery Managers who run incident, change and problem management. Together they work with the operations centres and the specialist engineering teams to keep the estate within the service levels it is measured against. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, and strong technical competence is a core requirement of it. The role is expected to step into complex faults alongside the engineers, guide the diagnosis and recovery, and judge the technical quality of the team's work. The role manages the team's 24/7 on-call operation, its escalation paths to the specialist engineering teams, and its service level objectives. The team treats operations as a software problem, and the role leads the work of turning what the team learns into runbooks, guarded automation and permanent fixes. 

 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead and manage the platform reliability team, including hiring, onboarding, performance, development and wellbeing across regions. 
  • Manage the team's 24/7 on-call and incident command rosters, with cover across regions. 
  • Serve on the incident command roster and act as incident commander for major incidents on rostered weeks, alongside the Service Delivery Managers. 
  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for the team: join complex faults, guide diagnosis and recovery, and review the technical quality of the root cause analysis, runbooks and automation the team produces. 
  • Manage the service level objectives for the services the team supports, and report service performance to leadership. 
  • Work with the specialist engineering teams on clear escalation paths and response commitments. 
  • Hold the team to its incident, change and problem management practice, and arbitrate when speed and process pull in different directions during an incident. 
  • Drive the team's runbook and automation work, so that common faults are fixed once and handled by runbooks or automation, and engineers have time to build automation between on-call weeks. 
  • Build a clear development path for the team's engineers into senior specialist roles, with mentoring and rotations agreed with the other engineering managers. 
  • Work with the Service Delivery Managers and the engineering teams so that new and changed services are ready to support in production. 
  • Turn production evidence, such as incident trends and repeat causes, into clear improvement requirements for the engineering teams, and follow them to closure. 
  • Manage customer and leadership reporting on service health with the Service Delivery Managers, and attend customer service reviews where contractual response commitments are discussed. 
  • Keep the team's ITSM, on-call and operational tooling fit for purpose. 

 

Skills & Experience 

  • Solid hands-on engineering experience in infrastructure operations or site reliability engineering (Linux, networking, storage, Kubernetes or virtualisation), with the technical depth to lead a recovery, question a diagnosis and judge whether an escalation carries enough evidence. 
  • Significant experience leading a 24/7 operations, SRE or production engineering team in a large-scale hosting, HPC, telecommunications, data centre or service provider environment, including running on-call rosters and incident response. 
  • Working ability in scripting or programming (for example Python, Go or Bash) and in infrastructure as code, enough to review the team's automation and runbook code. 
  • Working knowledge of site reliability engineering practice, including service level objectives, error budgets, toil reduction, runbook automation and production readiness, applied alongside formal incident, change and problem management. 
  • Clear communication and sound judgement, including under pressure. 
  • Experience with ITSM, on-call and observability tooling (for example Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty and Grafana). 
  • Experience building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at pace, coaching early-career engineers, setting performance expectations and growing people into senior roles. 

 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience as a major incident commander, including communicating with stakeholders under pressure and leading post-incident reviews. 
  • Experience operating GPU, HPC or AI infrastructure, including the failure modes of large-scale distributed training and inference. 
  • Experience in a multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environment with customer-facing reporting. 
  • Experience working under contractual response commitments and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. 
  • Experience setting up a new operations function or team, including rosters, escalation paths and standards. 
  • Experience leading teams across time zones with follow-the-sun handovers. 
  • ITIL or an equivalent service management qualification. 

 

Location & Reporting 

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required. 

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role serves on the incident command roster with the Service Delivery Managers and is the escalation point for the team outside hours. 

Reporting to: Reports to the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations, working under broad direction with a high degree of autonomy. This role leads a team of 5 to 10 engineers and service delivery staff. 

 

 

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

 

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

description:
Principal Program Manager – Operations Management – London (hybrid) or Remote UK

 

This role exists to ensure Convera’s most critical operational, technology, customer, and business issues receive clear ownership, coordinated execution, and timely resolution.

 

The Principal Program Manager for Operations Management serves as a trusted extension of the Head of Portfolio & Operations Management, within the Operations, Product & Tech Org, stepping into high-priority escalations, incidents, executive actions, and cross-functional challenges where ambiguity and urgency are high. The role contributes to business objectives by protecting customer trust, reducing operational and technology risk, improving organizational accountability, and enabling more effective executive decision-making. For customers, this translates into faster issue resolution, improved service reliability, fewer recurring incidents, and a more consistent experience when problems arise. 

 

The role sits at the center of Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Risk, Compliance, and executive leadership, driving alignment and accountability across functions. Success is measured by effective incident and escalation management, closure of executive actions, completion of root-cause investigations, implementation of corrective actions, improved operational visibility, and the establishment of scalable operating mechanisms that reduce future firefighting. Over time, the role evolves from leading responses to critical issues toward building the management disciplines, governance processes, reporting, communications, and operating rhythms that enable the Operations, Product & Tech organization to scale efficiently and perform predictably. 

 

You will be responsible for:

 

  • Lead critical escalations and high-impact incidents, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, driving resolution, managing war rooms, and maintaining executive visibility through closure. 
  • Drive executive action management and organizational accountability, translating leadership decisions into clear actions, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes. 
  • Conduct root-cause investigations and corrective action programs, identifying systemic issues and ensuring recommendations are implemented to prevent recurrence. 
  • Lead special situations and complex cross-functional initiatives, bringing structure, alignment, and momentum to high-priority business, operational, technology, and regulatory challenges. 
  • Establish operational visibility and performance management, including defect tracking, failure analysis, trend reporting, risk identification, and executive-level insights. 
  • Build and scale operating mechanisms, including governance routines, business reviews, executive communications, KPI reporting, readiness planning, portfolio visibility, and leadership operating cadences. 

 

You should apply if you have:

 

  • Extensive experience in program management, business operations, payments, fintech, financial services, or related disciplines, leading enterprise-scale initiatives in complex, regulated environments.  
  • Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, including customer-impacting operations, money movement, risk management, regulatory considerations, and complex incident response.  
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Commercial teams, with strong executive presence and judgment.  
  • Demonstrated success leading high-profile escalations, incident management, and cross-functional response efforts, with a strong root-cause mindset and focus on sustainable operational improvements.  
  • Experience designing and implementing operating models, governance frameworks, escalation protocols, or business processes from the ground up in ambiguous and evolving environments.  
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to synthesize complex issues into clear recommendations, executive updates, post-mortems, and actionable outcomes 

 

About Convera

 

Convera is the largest non-bank B2B cross-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs.

 

Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment.

As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

 

We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including: 

 

  • Market competitive salary and the opportunity to earn a bonus.
  • Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization.
  • A flexible approach to work (hybrid or remote).
  • Generous employee benefits, including private healthcare, and a catalogue of flexible benefits to choose from.
  • Paid holidays, time-off, and leave policies.
  • 3 additional “wellness days” off per year.
  • Paid time off for volunteering opportunities / charity (5 days per year).

 

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments.

description: Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid. Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling. Wat ga je doen Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. · Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie; · Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's; · Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders; · Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken; · Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering; · Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming; · Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces; · Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie; · Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op jouw plek Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen. Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. description: Wil jij impact maken aan de voorkant van onze uitdagende bouwprojecten? Heb je ruime technische kennis. Heb jij affiniteit met planning en prijsvorming? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau het verschil te maken! Dit wordt jouw baan Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan: · Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek. · Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject) · Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten · Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit) · Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers. · Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen. · Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten. Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen. Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! Dit breng je mee · Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of als bouwtechnoloog/projectorganisator. · Je hebt een afgeronde bouwkundige opleiding. · Je hebt ervaring met Asta powerproject en Revit. · Je hebt technisch inzicht en werkt gestructureerd. · Je kan goed samenwerken, neemt initiatief en denkt een stap vooruit. · Jij staat voor jouw oplossingen en kan deze mondeling goed toelichten aan o.a. uitvoering. · Je kunt snel schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en bent stressbestendig Deze punten geven een beeld van het profiel dat wij zoeken. Herken jij jezelf niet volledig in alle punten, maar denk je wel dat deze functie bij je past? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen €5.639,- €7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring is een uitloop mogelijk. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je na 2 maanden proeftijd een onbepaalde tijd contract. 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike. Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit. Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. Voor de generatie die een studieschuld heeft opgebouwd tijdens het nieuwe leenstelsel is er een voordelige regeling voor de aflossing van studieschuld. Je kunt jaarlijks een bedrag van je brutosalaris inleggen om je studieschuld af te lossen. Dura Vermeer verdubbelt jouw inleg. Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen? Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! description: About the Role We are looking for a hands-on, resourceful Recruiting & HR Operations Manager to help us attract, hire, and support exceptional talent as we grow. This role will primarily focus on full-cycle recruiting, partnering closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand business needs, build talent pipelines, and deliver an efficient, high-quality candidate experience. While recruiting will be the priority, this role will support onboarding, employee lifecycle administration, and day-to-day HR operations for our Swiss-based team when time allows. Reporting to the Fractional HR leader based in the US, you will help build scalable, consistent people practices while providing responsive support to employees and managers. This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys quick execution to make an impact, owning the details, building relationships, and balancing multiple priorities in a growing organization. Key Responsibilities Talent Acquisition Manage full-cycle recruiting for positions across the organization, from intake meetings and sourcing through interviews, offers, and closing candidates. Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, develop recruiting strategies, and establish clear selection criteria. Source candidates through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other creative channels. Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs. Coordinate interview processes, ensuring timely communication, structured evaluations, and a positive candidate experience. Manage offer processes, including compensation coordination, offer approvals, and preparation of employment contracts in partnership with HR and leadership. Track recruiting metrics, pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other key indicators to identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness. Maintain accurate applicant tracking system records and recruiting documentation. Support the development of consistent recruiting practices across locations while accounting for local market expectations. HR Operations Coordinate preboarding and onboarding activities, including background checks, system entry, equipment, relocation coordination, and orientation. Partner with hiring managers and cross-functional teams to ensure new employees have a smooth, engaging start. Support new-hire check-ins and identify opportunities to improve the onboarding experience. Support employee lifecycle processes, including new hires, employment changes, internal transfers, and departures. Assist with HR reporting, audits, and other operational projects as needed. Coordinate with external payroll providers, benefits partners, and local HR or employment advisors as needed. Support compliance with applicable Swiss employment requirements and internal policies in partnership with the Fractional HR leader and relevant local experts. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Work closely with the Fractional HR leader to prioritize recruiting and people initiatives aligned with business objectives. Build trusted relationships with employees, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners. Handle confidential employee and candidate information with discretion and sound judgment. Contribute to the development of consistent, scalable HR processes in a growing organization while recognizing the need for locally appropriate practices. Desired Skills and Experience 4+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, talent acquisition, and/or HR operations, ideally in a growing technology, energy, engineering, or other technical organization. Demonstrated success managing multiple open requisitions and delivering a strong candidate experience. Experience recruiting for technical, commercial, operational, or corporate roles; experience in engineering or energy-related hiring is a plus. Familiarity with Swiss employment practices and HR administration, or experience supporting employees in Switzerland. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate. 
 
Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow. 
 
Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you. 

The role

As Sector Lead, Insights Consulting, you will report to the Regional Head of Insights Consulting and be responsible for the success, growth and retention of our strategic clients within your assigned sector across the region.

You will provide strategic leadership for the sector, taking direct responsibility for key accounts while supporting Client Leaders in managing and developing medium-sized and smaller accounts. You will play a key role in driving client satisfaction, business growth and team performance.

Acting as a senior research strategist and thought leader in communications and marketing measurement, you will help clients understand the value of their measures through data-driven insights and strategic advice

Alongside your client responsibilities, you will lead, coach and develop a team of senior professionals, ensuring the delivery of high-quality insights and consulting services that meet the needs of both domestic and global clients.

Duties and responsibilities

The role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Drive sector growth and client retention: Develop and implement strategies to grow client relationships, strengthen retention and identify opportunities for account development within your sector.
  • Lead and develop the team: Manage, coach and mentor a team of Senior Insights Consultants and Insights Consultants, supporting their professional development and overall performance.
  • Provide strategic client leadership: Lead key accounts and support Client Leaders in developing and delivering effective strategies for medium-sized and smaller clients.
  • Support business development: Act as a senior communications and marketing research strategist and thought leader, contributing to new business opportunities, client pitches and upselling initiatives.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality products and services that meet client needs.
  • Drive innovation: Identify opportunities to improve our products and services, champion new approaches and support the adoption of innovative solutions across your sector.

Essential skills and experience

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Fluency in both English and German, with excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.
  • At least 5 years' experience in driving strategic customer growth, retention and account development.
  • 2–3 years' experience managing client relationships and leading or developing small teams.
  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to identify opportunities for business growth and long-term client partnerships.
  • Excellent client relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to coach and develop team members while maintaining high standards of client service and delivery.
  • A willingness to travel approximately 5–10% of the time.

What We Offer

Upon joining Cision, you will immediately have access to a range of benefits that are fully or partially funded by the company and form part of your overall benefits package. These benefits include:

  • Capital-forming benefits and a pension fund
  • Flexible working hours and mobile work
  • Commuter card subsidy
  • Subsidy for our partner EGYM Wellpass to access 7,500 premium fitness and wellness options
  • New and modern office in Gateway Gardens, Frankfurt
  • Professional development in a modern and globally leading company
  • Insights into the international media landscape
  • A dynamic global team
  • Work independently and self-driven in an innovative environment
  • Value-driven culture and team-oriented working
  • Work from abroad for a determined timeframe

 

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you! Please note that for this role, we are only able to consider candidates who are already based in the country of employment.

description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is the world's fastest-growing defence technology company, bringing commercial technology talent and venture funding to the defence and security sectors. Our technology helps Australia, the United States, and allied nations solve their hardest national security challenges by enabling operators to make better, more informed decisions in life-and-death situations. We have assembled a diverse team of experts in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor fusion, optics, and data analysis that are creating software and hardware solutions to radically evolve the capabilities of Australia, the United States, our allies, and commercial customers. If you are passionate about solving problems that have a real impact, come join Anduril and build the future of defence.

A critical part of the Anduril team is its Contracts / Commercial Managers, who play a crucial role in program success. They interface daily with a motivated team of program leadership, functional leadership, and customers in fast-paced environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a talented Contracts / Commercial Manager to support a variety of Government, International, and Commercial contracts and programs. In this role, you will oversee the full contract lifecycle for Anduril's government and commercial contracts, ensuring compliance, minimizing risk, and optimizing contract performance. The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of commercial and defence contracting with strong negotiation skills and a passion for supporting national security through technological innovation.

The position will be responsible for providing contract support for various Government contracts and commercial contracts. Support of these contracts will involve proposal support, contract negotiation, contract compliance, contract management, contract modifications, and contract close-out. This role works closely with the legal and proposal teams as well as across the spectrum of Anduril’s accounting, business operations, program, and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Execute contract management throughout the life of each contract.
  • Complete contract review and acceptance.
  • Oversee and prepare contract proposal planning and management and support preparation of proposals.
  • Ensure compliance with government regulations, legal requirements, and company policies.
  • Assist in identification, development, and implementation of new contract policies and processes.
  • Maintain comprehensive contract documentation and compliance records.
  • Provide contract summaries and ensure contract execution in accordance with government and company requirements.
  • Provide program managers and executives with contract briefs during the life of contracts.
  • Provide guidance on ASDEFCON requirements and other regulatory considerations.
  • Cultivate strong, ongoing relationships with internal/external customers.
  • Provide contractual guidance and risk mitigation strategies for contractual and business obligations.
  • Negotiate complex contractual terms with government agencies, prime contractors, and subcontractors.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of relevant contract management experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, government, or a related field.
  • A strong working knowledge of Australian Government contracting including ASDEFCON, Commonwealth Procurement Rules (CPRs), and/or Defence Security Principles Framework (DSPF) experience.
  • Experience with full life cycle contract management for various types of contract agreements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. You are highly respected amongst your peers and/or counterparts and known as someone who gets things done.
  • Australian citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience working for or with major Australian defence primes
  • IACCM/World Commerce & Contracting certification, Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or similar professional credentials
  • Graduate degree in business, law, government, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of AUKUS initiatives and Australia-US-UK defence collaboration framework

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. What does the team work on?

Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with 70+ million active accounts. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. What is the role?

The depth of query, content and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness in their search journey. Solving this customer problem is why we’re actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations to drive further innovation in search and discovery. The person in this role will leverage their technical skills, business intuition, and analytical thinking to build best-of-class AI-powered products. Communication and presentation skills are important. The role requires both high technical acumen and problem-solving abilities, motivation, and exceptional attention to detail. Every day, you’ll look at what exists and find ways to make it better.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks.   • Run online AB tests and analyse them against the critical business KPIs
  • Collaborate with US engineering teams as well as cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Nurture our ML ecosystem to make it withstand scale, developer velocity and future business shifts
  • Provide technical leadership to drive technical and ML roadmap for search ranking and monetisation
  • Help in recruiting new engineers. Interview, train, and mentor new team members

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. description: Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players Maneuver Marketing Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products. In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards, jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore. This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth! Your Next Role We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability. You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps. Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance. This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising. What You’ll Do 1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales. Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand. Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media. Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign. Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance. Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive. Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation. 2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates. Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows. Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently. 3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list. Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop. Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends. Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified. Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees. 4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance. Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense. Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate. Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them. Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance. 5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review. Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback. Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners. Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications. Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic. Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly. 6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively. Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content. Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use. Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels. Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content. Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role. 7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house. Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume. Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time. Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly. Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate. 7. Measure and Improve Performance You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic. You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns. Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program. Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment. Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership. Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format. Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches. How You’ll Succeed You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution. You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve. You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content. You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment. You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone. You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce. You introduce structure without slowing down execution. You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns. You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align. You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes. What You Bring Required 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability. Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for. DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category. Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it. Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house. Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships. Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them. Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved. Strongly preferred Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound. Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta. Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time. Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent. Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories. Experience partnering with healthcare professionals or subject-matter experts as brand partners. Understanding of paid social creative testing and direct-response fundamentals. Genuine interest in health, wellness, consumer behavior and social media culture. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it? AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. Why a designer now We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market. That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind. Role and Responsibilities As our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster. You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set. Journeys and engagement Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit. Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky. Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data. Growth surfaces Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels. Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from. Craft and UI ownership You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence. During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent. Design system and enablement Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan. Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with. How you work You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision. You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision. You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign. On a typical week On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience. On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves. In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details. On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined. We offer A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution; Competitive, benchmarked compensation; The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work; Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals; Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice; Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year; Pension plan; 5 Mental health days per year; Access to OpenUp mental health platform; Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read; All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; Free access to the office gym. Apply for the job Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate. P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. Who you are You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if: You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech. You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you. You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas. You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion. You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence. You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard. You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same. You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so. You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.
